item.title: Rewrite Captain Post - OPEN
item.content:encoded:
Hi, Rewrite Captain here.

Rewrites without the original author's permission only happen when:

  • The author cannot be located/contacted, AND
  • The article is in deletion range.

When it's trending downwards, we will sometimes put out a call for rewriters, to see if someone's interested in taking the article on. But even then, we won't just replace the article unless it's risking deletion.
